luke.description: The Luke instance attached to this component.

parentSelector.description:
A parent selector that can be used to distinguish between multiple instances of a component within a page.
This can be leveraged to create 1-to-1 mappings between {@link UITestComponent}s so that functions
called on a component are limited only to the scope of that component in the UI.

spinner.description: The spinner that masks the component when data is loading

renderingSelectors.description:
An array of selectors used to determine whether the page/component exist or is rendered.  These selectors will be searched
for within the {@link #parentSelector}.

timeout.description: The maximum amount of time that Luke will retry an action

titleSectionSelector.description: Selector for the collapsible component's title section {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent}

titleSelector.description: Selector for the collapsible component's title {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent}

secondaryTitleAsButtonSelector.description: Selector for the collapsible component's secondaryTitle when it's a button {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent}

secondaryTitleAsTextSelector.description: Selector for the collapsible component's secondaryTitle when it's text {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent}

contentSelector.description: Selector for the collapsible component's content (child components) {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent}

title: Representation of the {@link UiSdlCollapsibleComponent} component for testing purposes.
